---
title: "Portable surface report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
vertices <- matrix(
  c(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)
triangles <- matrix(
  c(0L, 1L, 2L, 0L, 1L, 3L, 0L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)
geometry <- SurfaceGeometry(vertices, triangles, hemi = "lh")
scene <- surface_scene(
  left = geometry,
  layers = list(
    surface_layer("effect", c(-2, -0.5, 1, 3), limits = c(-3, 3)),
    surface_layer("atlas", c(1, 2, 1, 2), limits = c(1, 2))
  ),
  fallback = "Left cortical surface with effect and atlas maps.",
  alt_text = "Interactive lateral view of a left cortical surface."
)
```

```{r scene, echo=FALSE}
surfwidget(scene, height = "480px")
```
